segments.text: Answerable to these two natures, are the two parts of Gods word. First, the Law, because it is the ministerie of death, it fitly serueth for the taming and mastering of the rebellious flesh: and the Gospell containing the bountifull promises of God in Christ, is as oyle, to power into our woundes, and as the water of life, to quench our thirstie soules: and it fitly serueth for the strengthening of the spirit.
